HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the meeting of Board of ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that the meeting of Board of Directors of the Company was held today, i.e., Friday, the 06th day of November, 2026 at the Registered Office of the Company situated at R-13, S/F, Greater Kailash-I, New Delhi-110048 which commenced at 02:00 P.M. and concluded at 09:15 P.M. inter alia to consider and approve the following: 
1. Independent Auditor's Limited Review Report on Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 as Annexure-A.
